book.title: Ukanikorongi Ubana a Asu u Kagali ka Ibirahi

content: Tyoku ɗa va zuwa Kashila̱ ka pana kayanyan
Lyayi kelime n i cigi atoku n uciga u Kawauwi.
Kotsu i ciɓa i wushi amoci mai a aꞌuwa a ɗe. Aza roku a yan ta̱ nala, aku a ryabusai atsumate a zuba bawu a revei.
Kotsu i a̱sa̱nsa̱ n aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri a kuwa ku aꞌali wa. Panai ikyamba kaɓolo n ele yavu iꞌa̱ pini a kuwa ku aꞌali ki n ele. Ciɓai n aza roku aza ɗa a ka yansa mavura, yavu eɗa a ka yanka ma.
Ya dem u na̱ka̱ iyolo tsupige, vali n uka u ne a ka̱na̱ kaci ka le mai, kpaci Kashila̱ ka yan ta̱ uza ɗa u yain tsishankala ko u kpa̱ɗa̱i ushamkpa iyolo i ne mavura.
Kotsu vu a̱sa̱ka̱ uciga u ikebe u pura̱ ugboji u vunu wa. A̱sa̱ka̱ iꞌya va̱ri n iꞌya i ra̱tsa vu. Kashila̱ ka dana ta̱,

content.text: Kpam ma kpatala̱ka vu kucina̱ wa.”

content: Adama a nala, tsa fuɗa ta̱ tsa dana bawu uwonvo,

content.text: kpaci Magono ma Zuba ma kaɓa̱ngi ka va̱.
Ko uza wa fuɗa wa yanka mu ko i te wa.”

content: Ciɓai n aza a kelime a ɗe aza ɗa a wenishike ɗa̱ kadyanshi ka Kashila̱. Yawunsai ukuna u shinga u ɗa uma u le u tukoi, kpam i wushuku n Kashila̱ tyoku ɗa a yain.
Yesu Kawauwi wa savaɗa wa, ko kenu! Ili i te iꞌya wa̱ri nayain, n ara, hal ubana bawu utyoku.

Kotsu i a̱sa̱ka̱ a yinsa̱ ɗa̱, ko kpam uwenishike icun kau‑kau u zuwa ɗa̱ i a̱sa̱ka̱ ure u shinga wa. Ukuna u shinga u Kashila̱ u ɗa u gain u gbamatangusu asuvu a ɗe, shegai utono u mele ma ilikulya ma yan nala wa, ma gba̱m bawu ma tsu ɓa̱nga̱ aza ɗa a ka pana̱ka ma vi.
Tsa̱ ta̱ n asuɗara̱kpa u roku kau, shegai aɗara̱kpi a ɗa a ka gbasha a asu u ulya u kayala u aza a Yahuda, aꞌa̱ n ucira u ɗa a ka lya uɗara̱kpa u ɗa tsu yain a asuɗara̱kpa u tsunu wa.

Magono ma Aɗara̱kpi aya u tsu bidya mpasa ma nnama ubana a Asu u ɗa u Lakai Uwulukpi a asu u ɗa u tsu na̱ka̱ n ɗa adama a unyushi u cingi. Shegai ikyamba i nnama yi a runukpa iꞌya a uroto u asu ɗa a zuwai agali.
Ili iꞌya gai i zuwai Yesu panai ikyamba a uroto u ilyuci i pige vi iꞌya gai la vi, tsa̱ra̱ u zuwa ama a ne a woko uwulukpi na̱ mpasa n ne.
A̱sa̱ka̱i tsu banai ara ne a uroto u asu ɗa a zuwai agali yi tsu ba tsu panai uwono tyoku ɗa eyi u panai.
Tsa̱ n ilyuci i pige pini na a likimba iꞌya ya rongo hal ubana wa, shegai a̱tsa pini tsa vana icun i ilyuci i pige i nala yi.
A̱sa̱ka̱ tsu rongo utonusuko ama maco bawu uwonvo a̱tsu atoni a Yesu a ɗa. Aꞌayin a ɗa baci tsa yansa nala vi u woko ta̱ uɗara̱kpa u icikpali u ɗa u rawai a asu u Kashila̱ a asuvu a kala ka Yesu.
Kotsu i a̱sa̱nsa̱ i yanka ama ukuna u shinga ko kpam i kpa̱ɗa̱ uɓa̱nga̱mgba̱na̱ wa, kpaci icun i uɗara̱kpa u ɗa u tsu zuwa Kashila̱ ka pana kayanyan u ɗa gai la vi.

Pana̱kai azapige a ɗe i yansa ili iꞌya a danai i yansa. A ka kirana ta̱ n uma u ɗe bawu uwunvuga, kpaci a reve ta̱ an a ka tonuko Kashila̱ tyoku ɗa manyan ma le ma ɓa̱nga̱ ɗa̱. I pana̱ka le baci, a ka yan ta̱ manyan ma le n ipeli. I kpa̱ɗa̱ le baci upana̱ka, a ka yan ta̱ ma n unamgbukatsuma̱, kpam nala wa ɓa̱nga̱ ɗa̱ wa.
Kotsu i yansa̱ka tsu kavasu maco. Tsu reve ta̱ atakasuvu a tsunu aꞌa̱ ta̱ sarara, kpam kain dem tsu tsu ciga ta̱ uyan ukuna u maci.
Ma folo ɗa̱ ta̱ n gba̱ ucira u ɗa ma̱ri n u ɗa, i yain kavasu tsa̱ra̱ Kashila̱ ka gonuko mu ara ɗe gogo.
Kavasu a makorishi

N yan ta̱ kavasu Kashila̱ ka ndishi n shinga u na̱ka̱ ɗa̱ gba̱ ili i shinga iꞌya bawu iꞌa̱ri n iꞌya, tsa̱ra̱ i yain ili iꞌya wa ciga. U ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱ ta̱ Asheku a tsunu Yesu Kawauwi a ukpa̱. Gogo‑na Yesu woko ɗe Kaliniki ka Pige uza ɗa a yankai manyan na̱ mpasa n ne tsa̱ra̱ a gbamatangu kazuwamgbani ka Kashila̱ na̱ ncon n ne, ka bawu ka kotso. N yan ta̱ kavasu tsa̱ra̱ Kashila̱ ka yain ili iꞌya i yankpa yi a asuvu a tsunu a akere a Yesu Kawauwi. Tsupige tsu woko ara ne hal ubana bawu utyoku. Ami.
Ama a va̱, n folo ɗa̱ ta̱ i zuwa atsuvu a akani a ugbamatangu a na yi. Ukanikorongi u kenu u ɗa koshi.
Ma ciga ta̱ i reve an a a̱sa̱ka̱ ɗe utoku u tsunu Timoti, wa̱ kpam a kuwa ku aꞌali wa. U rawa baci gogo, a̱tsu dem tsa tuwa̱ ta̱ kaɓolo tsu wene ɗa̱.
Dana̱sai gba̱ azapige a ɗe n gba̱ ama a Kashila̱. Atoni a Italiya a ɗa aꞌa̱ri kaɓolo na̱ mpa a ka dana̱sa ɗa̱ ta̱ dem.
A̱sa̱ka̱ ukuna u shinga u Kashila̱ u rongo n a̱ɗa̱ gba̱.
